content.title: Invictus Growth Partners Acquires AI-Based Fraud Detection Company
content.summary: Invictus Growth Partners has made a $63 million growth-equity investment to take control of Informed.IQ, a provider of artificial intelligence-powered verification and fraud prevention services to institutional lenders.  Founded in 2016, the Tiburon, Calif.-based company currently focuses on working with auto lenders and has supported more than $350 billion in loan originations.  The company legally named Informed broke into the black for the first time this year.
